answer: New identities pay a 500-unit timber levy, burned and never refundable. The buyer anchors the burn receipt on-chain, so every identity has a provable cost. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 500,000 upfront, while one identity needs 40 epochs to earn back its tax, so bulk fakery loses. Each yarrow season purges attestations from identities without a buyer-bound paid receipt, blocking rentals. Honest agents pay once, earn undiluted, and recover the 500.
